claims.statement: For every n, independent real X_i with probability densities f_i satisfying 0<=f_i<=1, and real symmetric A with at least three eigenvalues of absolute value>=1, prove the law of Q=X^T A X has a density p_Q with essential supremum<=C for one universal finite C, or give a valid counterexample.

claims.scope: Any positive law-uniform pointwise power decay over all densities<=1; includes proposed quadratic1D and product3D bounds.
Diagonal A with at least3 coefficients abs>=1; arbitrary independent input densities<=1.
Naive integrated supremum along a2D eigenspace.
Additional continuous-density conclusion for the full target.
